text: Outdoor activities like camping connect you with nature, providing a serene environment. A campfire, often used as a source of warmth and comfort, is a core element of camping. To set up your tent, you need sturdy poles, a harness, and a waterproof tarp. When you're ready to start your camp, select a suitable location, create a fire ring, and manage your flames. Safety is essential, so ensure your campfires are fully extinguished before leaving and follow all fire safety protocols. After that, take care of your tent, making sure it's securely fastened and that it's sealed to prevent water from entering.
